desc:
Welcome to Bambou, one of Roblox's largest asian restaurant roleplay groups!

At our game, you can be a customer and immerse yourself in the wonderful experience, be a waiter and serve customers, or be a chef and make delicious food at the hibachi grill! Take on the cafe role that suits you best at this restaurant, the decision is yours! 🏮

🔗 Join the 'Bambou' group for exclusive information and the ability to serve customers!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/2631105/Bambou

👍 Make sure to like the game if you want to see more updates!

🐼 We look forward to seeing you join our growing community!
